name: Tab Tweaks
description: Right-click the new tab button to open the clipboard in a new tab; double-click any tab to close it; in the collapsed sidebar, hovering a tab unfolds its title (split views and folders unfold whole). Each can be turned on or off in the mod settings.
author: dvgmdvgm

JS/clipboard-newtab.uc.js.description: Clipboard new tab on right-click, close tab on double-click.

JS/tab-peek.uc.js.description: Unfolds the hovered tab in the collapsed sidebar.
